PD-Defect: A Field-Captured Smartphone Image Dataset for AI-Based Inspection of Power Distribution Infrastructure
	


	
		
	
	
		TL;DR
	

PD-Defect is a field-captured smartphone image dataset for computer vision on power distribution infrastructure, collected with APEPDCL in Eastern Andhra Pradesh, India. The release comprises 20,476 annotated examples across object detection, image classification, keypoint detection, semantic segmentation, and perspective validation.
